head.title: Extension Freezer 3000

ol.li: Open chrome://extensions in a new tab and keep it open.
Go to the settings page of the extension you want to disable.
Click a freeze button below, then immediately switch to the chrome://extensions tab.
Spam the "allow access to file URLs" toggle for a few seconds — the extension should disable.
Flip that toggle again every few minutes to keep it disabled, or reopen this page if memory gets heavy.

div.div: ⚠ Your Chromebook may hang briefly during this process. That's normal.
